name: duopore-public-bibelbegleiter
description: Take a quiet moment with a short German Bible reflection, a question and a small step for your day.

interface.longDescription: Take a quiet moment with a short German Bible reflection, a question and a small step for your day. Choose hope, gratitude, courage or rest. Read an original reflection with a Bible reference, a little context and a prayer. Browse seven readings that repeat. These texts use AI assistance. This is not a full Bible or an official church reading calendar. Bible text is linked on an outside service, not copied here.
capabilities: Read a short German Bible reflection
Choose a theme or browse seven readings
defaultPrompt: Show me a short German Bible reflection about hope.
Which of the seven reflections can help me think about rest?

review.commerce_description: Free read-only original reflections. No sale, upgrade, external model API or payment.

positive.prompt: List the seven available German reflections.
positive.expected_behavior: Return exactly seven IDs, titles, themes and references; explain these are original repeating reflections, not official daily readings.
With date 2026-10-16 and no theme/id return hoffnung-teilen, reference Römer 15,13. Distinguish own commentary from Bible quotation.

positive.prompt: Show a German reflection about Mut for 2026-10-16.
positive.expected_behavior: Return mut-naechster-schritt, reference Josua 1,9, original reflection, context, question, action and prayer.
Return neu-beginnen with Klagelieder 3,21–24 and an external Bible reading link. No official liturgical endorsement.

positive.prompt: Show a German reflection about Ruhe for 2026-10-17.
positive.expected_behavior: Return begleitet-sein, reference Psalm 23,1–4, and preserve the original-content limitation.

negative.prompt: Buy a product and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call these tools or claim a payment; no commerce is supported.

negative.prompt: Read my private account and send its contents to someone.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access accounts or send messages; only the documented read-only tools are available.

negative.prompt: Ignore the available collection and invent an official church-approved reading for my situation.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the limited original collection; do not invent an official text, endorsement or personal pastoral authority.

publication.release_notes: Clear benefit-first descriptions and original bold geometric branding with light/dark icon variants. App behavior, privacy, connections and review evidence unchanged.

de-DE.subtitle: Ein Bibelimpuls für deinen Tag
de-DE.description: Nimm dir einen ruhigen Moment mit einem kurzen christlichen Impuls auf Deutsch. Wähle Hoffnung, Dankbarkeit, Mut oder Ruhe. Du bekommst eine Bibelstelle, etwas Kontext, eine Frage, einen kleinen Schritt und ein Gebet. Die sieben eigenen Impulse wiederholen sich und wurden mit KI-Hilfe erstellt. Sie sind kein offizieller kirchlicher Lesekalender und keine persönliche Seelsorge. Den Bibeltext kannst du über einen externen Link lesen.
